  verbs (`ONE_CLICK_SAFE_VERBS = {"approve"}`).

## Operator / Setup Notes

After upgrading the published CLI:

```bash
npm install -g @openrig/cli@0.3.3
rig --version    # expect 0.3.3
rig daemon stop
rig daemon start
```

Migration `042_rig_archive` applies automatically on first
post-upgrade daemon start. It is `ALTER TABLE rigs ADD COLUMN
archived_at TEXT` plus `idx_rigs_archived` — append-only,
non-destructive, no rigs-row restructure / rebuild / drop.
Existing rows are unaffected.

For the new `rig archive` surface: default reads still exclude
archived rigs at the daemon layer. With no rigs archived, no
behavior change. `rig ps --include-archived`, the
`?includeArchived=true` / `?archived=only` query params, and the
UI's lazy Archive section opt archived rigs back in.

For the new `rig add` surface: the member fragment file is a YAML
or JSON document using the rig spec's snake_case field names
(same authoring format as a `RigSpec` pod member). The MCP
`rig_add` tool accepts the same fragment shape.

For `rig down <name>`: previously-documented agent workarounds
that resolved the rig id by hand before calling `rig down` no
longer need to do that step. The id-based form continues to work
unchanged.

## Known Limitations / 0.3.3 Deferrals

- **Slice-21 FR-1 (native Codex session-id hook)**: scope-tipped
  to 0.4.0 after the build-time forensic. FR-2 (honest restore
  gate) ships alone in 0.3.3.
- **Slice-13 component 3 (auto-rollout dispatcher)**: the slice
  13 vertical's dispatcher / rollout-invocation layer is the
  skill-layer landing for this release, not product code. The
  product-code halves (13.1 parser + 13.2 binding index) ship in
  0.3.3; invocation is intentionally out of the shipped runtime
  bundle.
- **Slice-05 sub-scopes from 0.3.2**: agent / port / managed-app
  collision detection (Item 4.3); broader install-into-existing-rig
  pathway acceptance (Item 4.4); the `--target-name` CLI flag for
  install-time rig-name overrides. Carried forward; CLI-surface
  decision (A-breaking rename vs A-additive flag) still pending.
- **Slice-21 FR-4(d) accepted-queue-state schema**: deferred from
  0.3.2; new `accepted` queue state is a schema model change.
  Carried forward.
- **Onboarding journey + battle-hardening**: slices 04
  (new-user-journey), 08 (hooks-elite), 10 (rig-self), 11
  (personal-rig) physically moved to the `release-0.3.3` mission
  tree at 0.3.2 wrap; the 0.3.3 cut focused on usability + honesty
  surfaces ahead of the onboarding journey. Carried forward to a
  later release.
- **Workspace symlink alignment**: daemon-side workspace-resolver
  alignment with operator symlinked workspace roots remains a
  follow-up; non-blocking for 0.3.3.
- **Slice-13 permission-block-routing-architecture remains held**:
  big-green-light gated by operator review; `rigx-experimental`
  only; not split-deferred (stays held).
- **`rig view list/show --json` flag inconsistency** — wrapper-layer
  routing path remains; the daemon's `view show <name>` route
  returns JSON correctly when invoked directly. Workaround:
  human-readable output for now. Wrapper-layer fix is the
  documented target.

## Verification Performed

- `npm run lint` clean.
- `npm run build` clean across all workspaces.
- TypeScript checks clean on every touched file at per-commit
  guard across every shipped slice.
- Per-slice focused-suite tests green:
  - Slice 16: tmux-adapter buffer path (small + large) +
    Claude/Codex adapters large-payload delivery.
  - Slice 17: tmux-adapter dash-prefix discriminator
    (`-l -- '<text>'`); 77/77 in the touched suite.
  - Slice 18: cmux 130/130 unit tests; VM e2e 0.64.x launch +
    0.63.x non-regression.
  - Slice 19: archive route / repo / projection + UI
    `topology-archive-section` + `global-events` (archived /
    unarchived invalidation); AC-4 host-scoped no-cross-host-leak;
    AC-8 archive-vs-down-delete non-destruction discriminator.
  - Slice 22: down 22/22 (id-exact-first; archived-id reaches
    teardown; active+archived same-name -> active; archived-only
    name halts not_found; AC-3 active-active discriminator).
  - Slice 21 FR-2: 45/45 in the verifyResumeLaunch suite
    including the unresolved-gate discriminator, trust-gate,
    model-selection-gate, and poll-exhaustion coverage.
  - Slice 24: add-member-route 8/8; add (CLI) 8/8; edge
    validation +6 (domain + route + CLI); cli index/expand/MCP +
    daemon rig-expansion green (41 cli + 49 daemon).
  - Slice 99.0.6.3: session-transport + transport-routes 76/76;
    cli send 12/12.
  - Slice 99.0.6.1: whoami-service 15/15; cli whoami 20/20.
  - Slice 04.1: workflow-spec-cache + workflow-routes 44/44.
  - Slice 04.2: setup AC-1 asserts the path references
    `rig workflow specs` and does not use `rig workflow list`.
  - Slice 20: feed-classifier 17, attention-feed 17,
    verb-actions-one-click 6, verb-actions-optimistic-error 7,
    feed-card-terminal-drill 4, feed-decision-band-sort 5,
    feed-card-dismiss 12, activity-feed 25, session-preview-pane
    3 — 102/102 touched + adjacent.
  - Slice 13.1: release-surface 10/10; sample byte-identical
    across two runs (determinism).
  - Slice 13.2: affected-skills 12/12.
- Per-commit guard CLEAR across every shipped slice;
  velocity-qa adversarial dogfood + dual rev1 CLEAR on each
  merge.
- The cumulative-workspace test runs surface the documented
  pre-existing baseline (cmux / preflight / archived_at-harness /
  @tanstack dep cascade); ZERO regressions versus the v0.3.2 base
  on every shipped slice.

## Commits Included (highlights)

The full v0.3.2 -> v0.3.3 delta is 56 commits / 93 files /
+6,669 insertions / -238 deletions. The list below groups
load-bearing commits by theme:

### Startup Transport + Cmux Compatibility
- `fix(daemon)`: deliver large startup `send_text` via tmux
  buffer, not argv (slice 16).
- `fix(daemon)`: add `--` end-of-options sentinel to inline
  `send_text` (slice 17).
- `fix(daemon)`: cmux 0.64.x surface-listing `ref` / `id`
  normalization (slice 18).

### `rig archive` Affordance
- `feat(daemon)`: archive vertical — migration `042_rig_archive`,
  repository filter, projection filter, routes
  `/api/rigs/:id/archive` + `/unarchive`,
  `?includeArchived=true` / `?archived=only` query params.
- `feat(cli,ui)`: `rig archive` / `rig unarchive` commands,
  `rig ps --include-archived`, `rig up` archived-name refusal,
  UI archived-only hook + lazy "Archive" section under localhost
  host node.
- `fix(ui)`: wire `rig.archived` / `rig.unarchived` into global
  query invalidation.

### `rig add` / `rig add-member`
- `feat(daemon)`: `add_member` converge op on
  `PodRigInstantiator`; topology-converge spine
  (`Op` union + differ + `convergeOp`) scaffold.
- `feat(cli,daemon)`: `rig add` HTTP route + CLI command for the
  `add_member` converge op.
- `feat(cli)`: `rig_add` MCP tool.
- `fix(daemon,cli)`: honest edge validation — reject non-array
  edges + non-canonical kinds (shared `VALID_EDGE_KINDS` with
  rigspec schema).

### `rig down` Name-or-Id
- `fix(cli,docs)`: `rig down` resolves by name-or-id;
  `?includeArchived=true` summary fetch; archived-id reaches
  teardown; name-match active only; packaged-skill caveat
  retired across specs source + assets/plugins copy +
  `_canonical` mirror.

### Honest Outcomes
- `feat(daemon)`: honest Codex restore gate — unresolved gates
  are `attention_required`, not launch success (slice 21 FR-2).
- `feat(daemon,cli)`: `rig send --verify` honest delivery
  outcomes — `delivered` / `rendered-unconfirmed` / `failed`.
- `feat(daemon,cli,docs)`: `rig whoami` peers contract stated
  in-band — `peersNote` field + CLI clarifier; `peers[]` shape
  unchanged.

### Workflow Discovery + Instantiate
- `fix(daemon)`: resolve workflow instantiate by discovered name
  (slice 04.1 AC-3).
- `fix(cli,docs)`: golden path points to `rig workflow specs`
  for built-in discovery (slice 04.2 rev1-r2).

### For-You Manage-By-Exception
- `feat(ui)`: For-You drill-to-terminal + decision-band sort +
  one-click approve (slice 20).
- `fix(ui)`: enforce approve-only one-click in code — narrowed
  type + runtime `ONE_CLICK_SAFE_VERBS` allowlist.

### Auto-Feature-Rollout (product-code halves)
- `feat(cli)`: CLI release-surface parser POC (slice 13.1) —
  deterministic Commander-registration extractor; sample diff
  fixture; v0.3.1..v0.3.2 worked example.
- `feat(cli)`: skill <-> CLI-surface binding-index lookup
  (slice 13.2 component 2) — composes with 13.1; ratified join
  grammar; v0.3.2-affected-skills regression fixture.
- `fix(cli)`: drop `--version` flag token from the binding
  index (slice 13.2 guard B1).

See `CHANGELOG.md` for the agent-readable changelog with quick
verification commands and operator notes.

body.body:
# OpenRig v0.3.2 ## Summary OpenRig v0.3.2 ships Rigbundles as a first-class cross-primitive bundling mechanism, GAs the workspace + workflow operator surface, lands a 4-bug `rig up ` paper-cut fix-round, ships a 5-fix coordination + first-user-setup round (slice 21), scrubs internal substrate paths from daemon source + tests, wires `ConceptCard` to a shaped data source, and adds server-side priority windowing on For You. No schema-breaking migrations. Existing v0.3.1 databases upgrade on first `rig daemon start` (adds migration `041_rig_policy` for the new operator-context-mode bindings table — `CREATE TABLE` with no impact on existing data; binding rows are operator-authored at runtime). ## Included In This Release - **Rigbundles First-Class (slice 05)** — cross-primitive bundling for five content kinds (skills + plugins HYBRID + workflow_specs + context_packs + agent_images) routed end-to-end. `rig bundle create` auto-detects an author `bundle.yaml`, vendors declared content with both-sides path containment and symlink-escape protection, and emits an integrity-hashed manifest. `rig bundle install` routes each content kind to its canonical library at `$OPENRIG_HOME` with consumer-scan visibility. `rig bundle inspect` surfaces the cross-primitive content fields as first-class. CLI install timeout bumped (the 5-second cap was too short for tmux-session-bootstrapping installs). - **Workspace + Workflow GA (slice 01)** — operator-facing surface hardened. `rig workspace validate --max-files` strict-int regex; `rig workflow project --exit` enum guard; 3-part error returned before `client.post` for early-fail clarity; 14 new discriminator tests on the validator paths. - **`rig up ` Paper-Cut Fix-Round (slice 22)** — unblocks the homepage quick-start on fresh 0.3.1→0.3.2 installs. Four bounded fixes: - HTTP 4xx surface for pre-launch failures (`cycle_error` / `preflight_failed` / `validation_failed` / `service_boot_failed`) — was bare 500. - No orphan rig record on pre-launch failure — instantiator re-ordered + rollback path + compose teardown order tightened. - Path-form `rig up ` defaults `cwd` to the caller directory (closes the divergence between path-form and bare-form invocation). - `walkYamlFiles` skips standard noise dirs (`.worktrees`, `node_modules`, `.git`, `dist`, `.turbo`, `.next`) + stale `workflow_specs` rows prune at startup with an install-root preservation guard (so shipped built-in specs survive the prune). - **Coordination + First-User Setup Fix-Round (slice 21)** — five bounded follow-rounds: - FR-1: Coordination-model boot instinct surfaced in `core/openrig-user/SKILL.md` (`rig send` vs `rig queue` vs `rig queue handoff` + §1b doctrine). - FR-2: First-user workspace + workflow setup teaching content (skill + docs). - FR-3: MISSION_NOTES durable-pattern hardening (template + codemap convention + scope-primitive auto-scaffold via `rig scope mission create`). - FR-4: Queue ergonomics — `rig queue create --body-file ` (use `-` for stdin) kills the backtick-shell-corruption class for multiline bodies; first-class `--mission` / `--slice` flags compose into tags; `lastNudgeResult` wording fix; closure-vs-acceptance documented. - FR-5: `rig workspace doctor` subcommand — 7-check workspace readiness diagnostic (workspace root, missions folder, file allowlist, daemon alignment, daemon reload, optional slice docs, MISSION_NOTES presence). - **Daemon Test Substrate-Path Scrub (slice 14)** — internal-team substrate path shape scrubbed from 4 daemon source sites + 10 test files. Hook-constants de-duplicated. Privacy class closed for tracked source/test surface. - **`ConceptCard` Data Source (slice 17)** — wired to shaped backlog candidates; storytelling-adapter completion deferred from 0.3.1 is now complete. - **For-You Priority Windowing (slice 20)** — server-side attention query (Option 3): SQL predicate pushdown, exact-match attention regex, dismissal as string-keyed for queue-derived cards. - **Operator Context-Mode Bindings (slice 09)** — new `rig policy` command surface paired with a daemon-side typed-primitive store (migration `041_rig_policy`). Six modes (`sleep | desk | mobile | away | focus | debug`) bind to four scope tiers (`global_host | rig | workstream | qitem`) with a restate-and-confirm posture so scripts cannot silently apply a binding without explicit `--confirm`. Citation, effective-mode resolve, and `defaults` commands round out the surface. - **Scope Tree Primitive (slice 12)** — new `rig scope` command for operating the substrate scope tree (missions, slices, sub-slices) per `conventions/scope-and-versioning`. Mission-tier (`ls` / `show` / `create`) + slice-tier (`ls` / `show` / `create` / `ship` / `close` / `move`) commands. Auto-mints stable dot-IDs into mission frontmatter; mission templates include `release` / `placeholder` / `mission-notes`. ## User-Facing Changes ### Rigbundles First-Class `rig bundle` now ships first-class cross-primitive bundling: ``` rig bundle create -o [--name ] [--bundle-version ] [--include-packages ] [--rig-root ] [--notes ] [--min-daemon-version ] [--min-cli-version ] [--json] rig bundle inspect [--json] rig bundle install [--plan] [--yes] [--target ] [--skip-version-check] [--force] [--json] rig bundle history [--rig ] [--since ] [--json] ``` Content kinds routed at install: `skills`, `plugins` (hybrid), `workflow_specs`, `context_packs`, `agent_images`. Each kind lands in its canonical library under `$OPENRIG_HOME`; consumer-scan visibility is preserved. `bundle.yaml` author manifests are auto-detected when present. Vendoring uses both-sides path containment (source and destination) and symlink-escape protection. Integrity hashing is captured in the bundle manifest. `--skip-version-check` and `--force` on `install` are operator-explicit overrides for the install-time daemon/CLI compatibility gate and the install-time conflict gate respectively (NOT recommended for routine use; the overrides exist for known-good operator scenarios). `rig bundle history` reads `~/.openrig/bundle-audit.jsonl` — the audit ledger of every install — with optional filters on target rig name and earliest install time. ### Workspace Doctor (`rig workspace doctor`) 7-check workspace-readiness diagnostic against the daemon's resolved workspace: ``` rig workspace doctor [--workspace ] [--strict] [--json] ``` Checks: workspace root, missions folder, file allowlist, daemon alignment, daemon reload, optional slice docs, MISSION_NOTES presence. Default exit-code: non-zero only on `fail`. `--strict` makes warn-or-fail non-zero. The CLI overlays `OPENRIG_FILES_ALLOWLIST` from the operator's shell env so the diagnostic reflects the operator's intended allowlist even when the daemon's env is unchanged. ### Queue Ergonomics `rig queue create` accepts a body from a file or stdin and exposes first-class mission/slice scope: ``` rig queue create --source --destination \ (--body | --body-file ) \ [--mission ] [--slice ] \ [--priority

] [--tier ] [--tags ] \ [--target-repo ] [--no-nudge] \ [--expires-at ] [--id ] [--json] ``` `--body-file -` reads from stdin. `--mission ` / `--slice ` translate to `mission:` / `slice:` tags (compose with `--tags`). ### Operator Context-Mode Bindings (`rig policy`) ``` rig policy set [--scope ] [--qualifier ] \ [-- ...] [--evidence ] \ [--confirm] [--bearer ] [--json] rig policy show [--json] rig policy effective [--rig ] [--workstream ] [--qitem ] [--json] rig policy cite [--rig ] [--workstream ] [--qitem ] rig policy unset [qualifier] [--bearer ] [--json] rig policy defaults [--json] ``` `set` is restate-only without `--confirm` (the CLI echoes the proposed binding and exits with `exit 2` so scripts cannot silently apply). Six modes: `sleep | desk | mobile | away | focus | debug`. Four scopes: `global_host | rig | workstream | qitem`. `--qualifier` is required for `rig | workstream | qitem` scopes and explicitly rejected for `global_host`. Operator-edit verbs (`set --confirm`, `unset`) require an operator bearer token (`--bearer` or `OPENRIG_AUTH_BEARER_TOKEN` env). ### Scope Tree Primitive (`rig scope`) ``` rig scope slice ls [--mission ] [--state ] [--json] rig scope slice show [--mission ] [--json] rig scope slice create [--template ] [--title ] [--json] rig scope slice ship [--mission ] [--json] rig scope slice close --reason [--note ] [--mission ] [--json] rig scope slice move [--mission ] [--json] rig scope mission ls [--json] rig scope mission show [--json] rig scope mission create [--template ] [--id ] [--title ] [--json] ``` Top-level option `--workspace ` overrides workspace root (otherwise inferred from `cwd` or `$OPENRIG_WORK_ROOT`). ### `rig up` Paper-Cut Fixes ``` rig up [--plan] [--yes] [--cwd ] [--target ] [--existing] [--json] ``` - Pre-launch failures now return structured HTTP 4xx (`cycle_error` / `preflight_failed` / `validation_failed` / `service_boot_failed`) instead of bare 500. - Failed boots no longer leave orphan rig records on disk. - Path-form invocations default `cwd` to the caller directory. - `--existing` skips library-spec name resolution and treats `` as an existing rig name directly. ### MISSION_NOTES Durable Pattern (slice 21 FR-3) `rig scope mission create` auto-scaffolds `MISSION_NOTES.md` from `conventions/mission-notes/TEMPLATE.md` by default; `--no-mission-notes` opts out (rare). The convention codifies the durable-pattern model documented in workspace skills + canonical templates so missions ship with a uniform top-of-mind notes surface. ## Operator / Setup Notes After upgrading the published CLI: ```bash npm install -g @openrig/cli@0.3.2 rig --version # expect 0.3.2 rig daemon stop rig daemon start ``` Migration `041_rig_policy` applies automatically on first post-upgrade daemon start. It is a non-destructive `CREATE TABLE` with no impact on existing data; binding rows are operator-authored at runtime through `rig policy set --confirm`. For the new `rig policy` surface: opt-in default-none. With no bindings set, no behavior change. Use `rig policy defaults` to inspect the recommended per-mode 6×7 + default-scope mapping before authoring. For the new `rig scope` surface: read-only against workspace by default (`ls`/`show`); authoring verbs (`create`/`ship`/`close`/`move`) operate on the substrate scope tree as advertised. Use `--workspace ` to override the resolved workspace root. ## Known Limitations / 0.3.3 Deferrals - **Slice-05 Item-3 sub-scopes deferred to 0.3.3**: agent/port/managed-app collision detection (Item 4.3); broader install-into-existing-rig pathway acceptance (Item 4.4); the `--target-name` CLI flag for install-time rig-name overrides. Design-contingent on the CLI surface decision (A-breaking rename vs A-additive new flag). - **Slice-21 FR-4(d) accepted-queue-state schema deferred to 0.3.3**: the new `accepted` queue state is a schema model change; carried forward per the banked release-triage philosophy. - **Onboarding journey + battle-hardening deferred to 0.3.3**: slices 04 (new-user-journey), 08 (hooks-elite), 10 (rig-self), 11 (personal-rig) physically moved to the `release-0.3.3` mission tree at wrap. - **Workspace symlink alignment**: the daemon-side workspace-resolver alignment with operator symlinked workspace roots is a follow-up surfaced by slice-21 FR-5 QA; non-blocking for 0.3.2. - **Slice-13 permission-block-routing-architecture remains held**: big-green-light gated by operator review; `rigx-experimental` only; not split-deferred to 0.3.3 (stays held). - **`rig down ` still returns HTTP 404** — name-based teardown still doesn't resolve through the daemon down route at v0.3.2; use `rig down --delete` instead. Carries forward as known issue. - **`rig view list/show --json` flag inconsistency** — flag scaffolding on the wrapper-layer routing path remains; the daemon's `view show ` route returns JSON correctly when invoked directly (per v0.3.1 cutover evidence). Workaround: use human-readable output for now. Wrapper-layer fix is the documented target. ## Verification Performed - `npm run lint` clean. - `npm run build` clean across all workspaces. - `npm run test:repo` green. - Daemon test suite: 3996 PASS at slice-22 close. - TypeScript checks clean on every touched file at per-commit guard. - Per-commit guard CLEAR across every shipped slice; velocity-qa adversarial dogfood + orch heavy pre-merge verify on each merge. - Post-QA-fix deltas (when present) routed back to guard before merge per the banked qa-fix-lands-post-guard pattern. - Review-lead continuous-parallel-review ADVISORY-CLEAN on slice-22 close with five POSITIVE observations. ## Commits Included (highlights) The full v0.3.1 → v0.3.2 delta is 143 commits / 203 files / +29,028 insertions / −2,081 deletions. The list below groups load-bearing commits by theme: ### Rigbundles First-Class - `feat(daemon,cli)`: cross-primitive bundle routing — five content kinds plumbed end-to-end with both-sides path containment + symlink-escape protection + integrity hashing. - `feat(cli)`: `rig bundle` surface — `create` / `inspect` / `install` / `history` subcommands with operator-explicit override flags on install. ### Workspace + Workflow GA - `feat(daemon,cli)`: workspace `validate --max-files` strict-int regex; workflow `project --exit` enum guard; 3-part error before `client.post`. - `feat(cli)`: 14 new discriminator tests on the validator paths. ### `rig up ` Paper-Cut Fix-Round - `fix(daemon)`: HTTP 4xx surface for pre-launch failures. - `fix(daemon)`: no orphan rig record on pre-launch failure. - `fix(cli)`: path-form `rig up` defaults `cwd` to caller dir. - `fix(daemon)`: `walkYamlFiles` skips standard noise dirs + stale `workflow_specs` row prune with install-root preservation. ### Coordination + First-User Setup Fix-Round (slice 21) - `feat(skill)`: coordination-model boot instinct surfaced in `core/openrig-user/SKILL.md`. - `feat(docs)`: first-user workspace + workflow setup teaching. - `feat(cli)`: MISSION_NOTES auto-scaffold via `rig scope mission create`. - `feat(cli)`: `rig queue create --body-file` + first-class `--mission` / `--slice` flags. - `feat(daemon,cli)`: `rig workspace doctor` 7-check diagnostic. ### Daemon Test Substrate-Path Scrub - `chore(privacy)`: substrate path shape scrubbed from daemon source + test surface; hook-constants de-duplicated. ### ConceptCard Data Source - `feat(ui,daemon)`: wire `ConceptCard` to shaped backlog candidates. ### For-You Priority Windowing - `feat(daemon)`: server-side attention query with SQL predicate pushdown. - `feat(ui)`: dismissal as string-keyed for queue-derived cards. ### Operator Context-Mode Bindings - `feat(daemon)`: migration `041_rig_policy` + typed-primitive store. - `feat(cli)`: `rig policy` command surface (`set` / `show` / `effective` / `cite` / `unset` / `defaults`). ### Scope Tree Primitive - `feat(cli)`: `rig scope` command surface — mission + slice tiers. - `feat(cli)`: scope templates (release, placeholder, mission-notes, bug-fix, research, etc.) ship under `dist/lib/scope-templates/`. ### Privacy and Release Prep - `chore(privacy)`: pre-release scrub of residual founder-attribution comments + an internal-shape substrate-path JSDoc example. See `CHANGELOG.md` for the full agent-readable changelog with quick verification commands and operator notes.

body.body:
# OpenRig v0.3.1

## Summary

OpenRig v0.3.1 builds on v0.3.0 with operator-facing UX work, the headline
Claude auto-compaction policy, a dashboard + For You visual refresh, the
Plugin Primitive v0 surface (`rig plugin`), Library Explorer finishing
(skills + plugins + specs with real folder browsing), Settings Destination
Explorer, action outcome + inline error UX, and a comprehensive privacy
hygiene pass.

No schema-breaking migrations. Existing v0.3.0 databases upgrade on first
`rig daemon start` (adds migration `040_workflow_specs_diagnostic` — two
new diagnostic columns on `workflow_specs` cache, `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN`
with safe defaults).

## Included In This Release

- **Claude Auto-Compaction Policy** — operator-configurable session
  auto-`/compact` with safe defaults (opt-in default-off; no behavior
  change unless explicitly enabled). 7 new ConfigStore keys; 6-stage
  daemon-to-LLM lifecycle (pre-prep prompt → compact → handshake →
  restore → compliance audit → cooldown); PreCompact hook +
  SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit bridge.
- **Plugin Primitive v0** — `rig plugin` command surface (read-only at
  v0: `list`, `show`, `used-by`, `validate`). Plugin discovery from
  `$OPENRIG_HOME/plugins/`, vendored-and-provenance pattern. No
  `install` verb at v0; deferred to 0.3.2.
- **Library Explorer Finishing** — skills + plugins + specs as a
  fully operator-facing surface with real folder browsing. New
  daemon-owned library discovery API (`/api/skills/library`,
  `/api/skills/:id/files/...`, `/api/plugins/:id/files/...`).
- **Settings Destination Explorer** — settings became a 4-item
  Explorer destination matching Topology / Project / Library / For-You
  pattern, with `/settings`, `/settings/policies`, `/settings/log`,
  `/settings/status` sub-routes.
- **Dashboard And For You Visual Refresh** — both routes adopt a
  shared "vellum" surface language (translucent stone-tinted cards,
  paper-grid background, ambient shadow, mono+dot kind indicators,
  L-shaped corner-bracket registration marks). Single source of truth
  between production and `/lab/vellum-lab`.
- **For You Storytelling Adapter** — Progress / Shipped / Incident /
  Approval card kinds wired to real data (missions, slices, activity
  feed, queue items). ApprovalCard surfaces real queue items waiting
  on approval.
- **Action Outcome + Inline Error Surface** — queue-item verb actions
  (Approve/Deny/Route/Hold/Drop/Annotate/Handoff) render outcomes
  immediately on success and surface failures inline without
  silently reverting. Closes a demo-blocking silent-revert bug.
- **Mobile Drawer Behavior** — 375px Explorer drawer now layers above
  the rail tray for Settings / Project / Library / For-You. Topology
  mobile drawer is intentionally hidden in 0.3.1; scheduled for full
  restoration in 0.3.2.
- **Vendored Skill Provenance** — vendored skills declare upstream
  lineage via `metadata.openrig` frontmatter and (when modified) a
  companion `OPENRIG.md` sidecar. Applied to all 10 process-skill
  surfaces.
- **Workflow specs diagnostic surface** — migration `040` adds
  `status` + `error_message` columns to the `workflow_specs` cache so
  the Library UI can render parse/validation errors as diagnostic
  rows instead of hiding them.
- **Privacy hygiene pass** — three filter-repo passes scrubbed
  personal data, internal references, and historic versions from
  history; commit subjects and bodies polished for public surface.
  Backup repos preserved for rollback.

## User-Facing Changes

### Claude Auto-Compaction Policy

Operator-configurable auto-`/compact` for Claude sessions, with safe
defaults:

- **Opt-in default-off**: nothing changes unless you explicitly enable
  the policy. With no policy configured, the daemon never sends an
  auto-`/compact`.
- **7 new ConfigStore keys** in the `policies.claude_compaction.*`
  namespace: `enabled`, `threshold_percent` (strict integer 1-100),
  `compact_instruction` (operator-supplied; appended to `/compact`
  args when set), `message_inline`, `message_file_path`,
  `pre_compact_instruction`, `post_restore_audit_instruction`. Strict
  validation across all source layers (`set`/`POST`/env/file). Invalid
  env values fall back to defaults with a stderr warning rather than
  silently coercing.
- **5 operator-editable prompt surfaces** in Settings → Policies UI:
  pre-compaction prep, compact instruction, post-compaction restore
  (inline), restore file path, post-restore audit. Daemon-owned
  wrappers (usage/threshold framing, trust-channel preservation,
  marker paths, read-depth enforcement, turn-boundary handshake,
  dedup + cooldown) are non-editable.
- **6-stage lifecycle**: pre-compact prep prompt (save-game-before-quit
  mental-model restore map) → `/compact` with operator instructions
  → post-compact turn-boundary handshake → restore prompt with
  defense-in-depth fallback chain → compliance audit (forces
  FULL/PARTIAL/NOT_READ table) → 10-minute cooldown.
- **Safety hardening**: typed prompt drafts classified as attention
  state so auto-`/compact` retries later instead of overwriting human
  input. Send-failure does not advance dedup state. Re-arm requires
  threshold-crossing.

### New `rig plugin` Command (read-only at v0)

```
rig plugin list                   # Discoverable plugins across vendored + runtime caches
rig plugin show <id>              # Plugin manifest + skills + hooks + mcp servers
rig plugin used-by <id>           # Agents referencing this plugin
rig plugin validate <path>        # Validate plugin manifest + skill frontmatter
```

No `install` verb at v0 — installation is explicit operator copy or
symlink to `$OPENRIG_HOME/plugins/<plugin-id>/`. See each plugin's
`OPENRIG-INSTALL.md` for the documented copy/symlink workflow. A
`rig plugin install <substrate-path>` verb is deferred to 0.3.2.

### Library Explorer Finishing

The Library destination (skills + plugins + specs) is now fully
operator-facing:

- No duplicate top-level entries (`> SKILLS` / `> PLUGINS` rows removed
  from `SpecsTreeView`; bottom-row clicks navigate + expand the tree).
- Plugins above Skills in the tree.
- 32 OpenRig-managed shared skills are now discoverable in production
  VM environments (previously empty due to workspace-relative path
  lookup).
- Daemon-owned library discovery API: `GET /api/skills/library`,
  `GET /api/skills/:id/files/list?path=...` + `/files/read?path=...`,
  parallel routes under `/api/plugins/:id/`.
- Real file-browser + docs-browser on plugin and skill detail pages.
  Markdown auto-renders; non-markdown files render as text. Folder
  navigation works.
- Rolled-up index pages at `/specs/skills` and `/specs/plugins` with
  flat-row listings, source labels, file counts, and entry links.

### Settings Destination Explorer

Settings is now a top-level Explorer destination matching the Topology /
Project / Library / For-You pattern:

- `/settings` (general config keys form)
- `/settings/policies` (Claude auto-compaction policy form lives here)
- `/settings/log`
- `/settings/status`

Old top-row tab navigation removed. Shared `SettingsPageShell` chrome
across all 4 sub-routes.

### Dashboard And For You Visual Refresh

A coordinated visual refresh to a shared "vellum" surface language:

- **Dashboard `/`** — full rewrite over new `dashboard/vellum/`
  primitives. Hero typography ("WELCOME BACK") at display-lg + headline-
  bold. Tactical instrument-panel stats line with tabular numerals.
  Six destination cards (Topology / Project / For You / Library /
  Search / Settings) share the numeral-layout treatment. Real-data
  hooks: `useRigSummary`, `usePsEntries`, `useSpecLibrary`.
- **For You `/for-you`** — both card systems unified to the vellum
  recipe: storytelling band (`CardShell` rewritten with bg-stone-100/45
  + backdrop-blur + ambient shadow + corner brackets) and queue-item
  `FeedCard.tsx` (same outer chrome; vellum bordered-no-fill action
  buttons with hover-invert and 44px touch targets).
- **Single source of truth** between `/dashboard` and
  `/lab/vellum-lab` via `packages/ui/src/components/dashboard/vellum/`.
- **Lab routes** — `/lab/card-previews`, `/lab/vellum-lab`,
  `/lab/vellum-bg/{a-large,b-small,c-allover}` are checked-in
  experiment surfaces for designer iteration. Reachable in production
  by direct URL; not linked from main navigation.

### For You Storytelling Adapter

The storytelling band at top of `/for-you` now wires four card kinds to
real data:

- **Progress** — first 2 active missions (`useMissionDiscovery`)
- **Shipped** — slices with status = shipped/complete/done (capped at 3;
  from `useSlices`)
- **Incident** — slices with status = blocked/failed/danger (capped at 3)
- **Approval** — queue items waiting on approval, from
  `useActivityFeed` + `classifyFeed` (capped at 2)

`ConceptCard` component is preserved in source but not emitted by the
production adapter; a deliberate data-source decision is scheduled for
0.3.2.

### Action Outcome And Inline Error Surface

Queue-item verb actions (Approve/Deny/Route/Hold/Drop/Annotate/Handoff):

- On success, `ActionOutcomePanel` renders immediately ("Approved by X",
  "Routed by X to Y") — no waiting for audit-log roundtrip.
- On error, a tertiary-bordered error block renders below the verb
  buttons with the daemon's error message; verb-selection state is
  preserved so the operator can correct and retry.
- Replaces the prior silent-revert UX. Regression test guards the class
  explicitly.

## Operator / Setup Notes

After upgrading the published CLI:

```bash
npm install -g @openrig/cli@0.3.1
rig --version    # expect 0.3.1
rig daemon stop
rig daemon start
```

Migration `040_workflow_specs_diagnostic` applies automatically on first
post-upgrade daemon start. It is a non-destructive `ALTER TABLE ADD
COLUMN` with safe defaults (existing rows retroactively get
`status: 'valid'`). No manual action required.

For Claude auto-compaction policy: opt-in default-off. Visit
`/settings/policies` to configure. Recommended for sessions where
context exhaustion is a recurring operational concern. Read the docs
section in the Settings UI before enabling.

For the new `rig plugin` surface: no behavior change unless you install
plugins. Bundled `openrig-core` plugin ships with the daemon (11 skills).
Operators can install `gstack` (45 skills) or `obra-superpowers`
(14 skills) by following each plugin's `OPENRIG-INSTALL.md` workflow.

## Known Limitations

- **`rig down <name>` still returns HTTP 404** — name-based teardown
  still doesn't resolve through the daemon down route at v0.3.1. Use
  `rig down <rigId> --delete` instead. Carries forward as known issue
  to v0.3.2.
- **`rig queue list --json --limit` and `rig view list/show --json`
  flag inconsistency** — flags scaffolded but not fully wired. Use
  human-readable output for now. Carries forward to v0.3.2.
- **Topology mobile drawer hidden** at 375px viewports in 0.3.1
  (intentional; clicking the hamburger triggered a pre-existing
  `TopologyTableView` renderer cascade). Full restoration scheduled
  for 0.3.2 via a dedicated render-path slice.
- **`ConceptCard` component preserved in source** but not emitted by
  the production For You adapter. A deliberate data-source decision is
  scheduled for 0.3.2.
- **`/lab/*` routes ship to production builds** intentionally per
  founder direction; 0.3.2 adds an index page + per-lab banner +
  manifest pattern.
- **Plugin install ergonomics** — v0 plugin install is operator-driven
  copy or symlink; first-class `rig plugin install <substrate-path>`
  is deferred to 0.3.2.
- **Lifecycle classifications** remain truthful but still rely on
  heuristics rather than perfect provider-native primitives in some
  recovery paths.

## Verification Performed

- `npm run lint` clean.
- `npm run build` clean across all workspaces.
- `npm run test:repo` green.
- Daemon test suite: 3600 pass, 1 pre-existing host-env-sensitive
  failure on `restore-check-routes` reading malformed local Claude
  settings (banked as environment-dependent class).
- UI test suite: 1106 pass / 0 fail (post-test-fixes merge; was 1093
  pass + 3 failing on stale-test pre-fix).
- TypeScript checks clean on all touched files.
- Code review (review-lead, advisory-clean) on every merge in the
  release window.
- Founder-walk VM at `http://100.95.124.51:17459/` walked end-to-end
  on host-main `4d88d98d` with realistic demo seed (8 seeded queue
  items, 8 feed events, 4 verified `/for-you` action scenarios
  including the inline error path).

## Commits Included (highlights)

The full v0.3.0 → v0.3.1 delta is 224 commits / 376 files / +37,391
insertions / −3,153 deletions. The list below groups load-bearing
commits by theme:

### Claude Auto-Compaction Policy
- `feat(daemon,cli)`: Claude auto-compaction policy scaffolding +
  ConfigStore keys
- `feat(daemon)`: 6-stage compaction lifecycle (pre-prep → compact →
  handshake → restore → compliance → cooldown)
- `feat(daemon)`: PreCompact hook + SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit
  bridge for marker restoration
- `feat(daemon)`: SessionTransport draft-attention classification +
  send-failure dedup discipline

### Plugin Primitive v0
- `feat(daemon,cli)`: `rig plugin` command + plugin discovery surface
- `feat(daemon)`: plugin manifest + skill provenance metadata schema
- `chore(skills)`: vendoring metadata + `OPENRIG.md` sidecars for 10
  process-skill surfaces

### Library Explorer
- `feat(daemon)`: library discovery API
  (`/api/skills/library`, `/api/{skills,plugins}/:id/files/list+read`)
- `feat(ui)`: SpecsTreeView dual-action + plugin/skill detail file
  browsers
- `feat(ui)`: rolled-up `/specs/skills` and `/specs/plugins` index
  pages

### Settings Destination Explorer
- `feat(ui)`: 4-route Settings Explorer destination
  (`/settings`/`policies`/`log`/`status`) with shared `SettingsPageShell`

### Dashboard + For You Visual Refresh
- `redesign(dashboard)`: full rewrite over `dashboard/vellum/`
  primitives + 6 destination cards
- `redesign(for-you)`: vellum-coherent storytelling cards + queue-item
  FeedCard chrome unification
- `refactor(dashboard)`: extract vellum primitives — single source of
  truth between `/dashboard` and `/lab/vellum-lab`
- `simplify(dashboard)`: drop back layer + back vellum sheet; add
  ambient shadow
- `merge(release)`: storytelling adapter extension — approval cards
  wired to real data
- `feat(for-you)`: wire ApprovalCard to real data; remove ConceptCard
  from production switch
- `fix(for-you)`: optimistic action outcome + inline error surface in
  VerbActions

### Migration 040 (workflow_specs diagnostic)
- `feat(daemon)`: migration 040 adds `status` + `error_message`
  diagnostic columns to `workflow_specs` cache

### Final test alignment
- `test(ui)`: fix 3 pre-existing failures — match deliberate design
  changes
- `docs(changelog)`: cover 0.3.1 dashboard + for-you visual refresh +
  action UX

### Privacy hygiene
- Three filter-repo passes (LOCAL-INSIGHTS personal-data scrub +
  commit-body internal-doc reference scrub + file-content historic
  versions scrub)
- Commit subject rewrites to remove privacy-scream patterns
- Force-pushed at commit `7e55d9d3` as the privacy-cleaned baseline

See `CHANGELOG.md` for the full agent-readable changelog with quick
verification commands and operator notes.

body.name: OpenRig v0.3.0
body.body:
# OpenRig v0.3.0

## Summary

OpenRig v0.3.0 turns the 0.2 coordination substrate into a more polished
operator product. It ships the redesigned shell, generic workflow starters,
mission-shaped workspace support, project observability, curated bundled skills,
runtime graphics, context telemetry, and release-hardening work for a cleaner
fresh install.

This release keeps the reusable primitives for queue handoff, workflow runtime,
watchdog supervision, artifact/proof surfaces, and agent coordination, while
the public starter content is intentionally generic.

## Included In This Release

- V1 shell redesign with the vellum visual system, two desktop chrome regions,
  topology graph/table/terminal modes, drawer viewers, Project, For You, Queue,
  Library, Settings, and proof-oriented detail surfaces.
- Generic starter workflow specs:
  - `conveyor` for station-style work where multiple packets can be active
    across the topology at once.
  - `basic-loop` for a one-packet-at-a-time walkthrough flow.
- `conveyor` starter rig and matching agent specs for intake/planning/building
  and review-oriented work.
- Mission-shaped workspace defaults and read-only nested mission/slice indexing.
- Project observability upgrades across For You, Story, Queue, Tests, Project
  rollups, proof screenshots, and qitem drawers.
- Runtime/tool graphics package applied across topology, queue, project metadata,
  proof rows, terminal previews, and agent identity marks.
- Terminal preview improvements, activity indicators, handoff edge animation,
  and context usage telemetry in topology table/terminal views.
- Runtime skill discovery from filesystem skill roots during profile resolution.
- Pre-release CLI/daemon cleanup: bounded transcript rotation, `rig send`
  message envelopes, OpenRig install/init marker naming, and public-release
  terminology cleanup.

## User-Facing Changes

### Redesigned Shell

The UI now uses the V1 shell model with a narrow rail, destination-specific
Explorer region, center workspace, and named-trigger drawer. Topology pages have
graph, table, and terminal modes at one stable URL. Drawer viewers handle queue
items, files, sub-spec previews, terminal previews, and proof assets without
turning every reference click into a full-page navigation.

### Starter Workflows And Rigs

The release includes generic workflow examples rather than project-specific
automation recipes. `conveyor` demonstrates station-based flow with natural
queue backpressure. `basic-loop` demonstrates a simple one-token-at-a-time loop.
The `conveyor` rig is the public workflow starter. `product-team` remains the
more advanced human-operator-driven starter topology.

### Project And Proof Visibility

Project surfaces now distinguish current and archived work, show mission/slice
hierarchy, route mission labels to mission pages, and expose story/tests/proof
rollups. For You and Queue cards hydrate qitem bodies, proof images, audit
outcomes, and next-action state. Tests proof screenshots open in an in-page
viewer.

### Topology And Runtime Visibility

Topology now has a hybrid multi-rig graph, expand/collapse controls, activity
rings, animated handoff edges, runtime/tool marks, context percentage/token
displays, and a terminal fallback view. Agent detail surfaces now use the
canonical live node details view.

### Skills And Starter Guidance

Bundled skills were curated for starter coherence. Runtime skill discovery now
finds valid `SKILL.md` files in runtime and workspace skill roots, with
rig-local resources taking precedence over broader user libraries.

## Operator / Setup Notes

- Fresh workspace defaults are mission-shaped and derive from
  `workspace.root`. Use `rig config init-workspace` to create the default
  workspace structure.
- The repo uses npm workspaces and the tracked root `package-lock.json`.
  `pnpm-lock.yaml` files are not release artifacts.
- Root-level runtime projection files such as `CLAUDE.md` are intentionally not
  tracked in the product repo.
- Deprecated `RIGGED_*` aliases remain only for the original runtime env keys:
  `daemon.port`, `daemon.host`, `db.path`, `transcripts.enabled`, and
  `transcripts.path`. New typed config keys use `OPENRIG_*` only.
- Existing local workflow specs can still be installed from workspace/spec
  locations; product source only bundles the generic starter workflows.

## Known Limitations

- Plugin support is not part of 0.3.0. Plugin-packaged skills and external
  plugin distribution are planned for a later release.
- The public starter workflows are examples, not a complete packaged automation
  methodology.
- Some broad CLI tests are sensitive to local daemon port/config state. Focused
  release-path tests and build/lint gates were used for the final push gate.

## Verification Performed

- `npm run lint`
- `npm run build`
- `npm run test:repo`
- Focused CLI, daemon, and UI tests for release hygiene, config boundaries,
  starter skill discovery, shell/topology behavior, and project observability.
- Source scans for personal paths, internal attribution phrasing, default
  fallback assumptions, and unwanted legacy env aliases on new typed keys.

## Commits Included

This release contains the accumulated product work since v0.2.0, including:

- Shell redesign V1 phases and polish slices.
- Project observability phases A-G plus follow-up fixes.
- Graphics package and broadened runtime/tool marks.
- Pre-release UI and CLI/daemon hardening.
- 0.3.0 starter refresh and release hygiene commits.

body.name: OpenRig v0.2.0
body.body:
# OpenRig v0.2.0

## Summary

OpenRig v0.2.0 is a major step forward. It ships a durable
daemon-backed coordination layer — streams, queues, projects, views,
watchdog supervision, and workflow runtime — together with a redesigned
restore experience, an agent-starter registry, cross-host operations,
and a wide set of lifecycle and recovery hardening fixes. This is the
first public release after a long internal hardening cycle, so the
delta from v0.1.12 is large.

## Included In This Release

- A new daemon-owned coordination layer: `rig stream`, `rig queue`,
  `rig project`, `rig view`, `rig watchdog`, and `rig workflow`.
- An agent-starter registry that lets RigSpec members reference named
  startup-priming entries (`starter_ref`) instead of inlining them.
- A new restore-packet command surface for capturing agent
  conversation packets across runtimes.
- New member-level launch source modes: `session_source: { mode:
  rebuild }` and `session_source: { mode: fork }`.
- Cross-host operations: `rig ps`, `rig whoami`, `rig send`, and
  `rig capture` accept `--host` for SSH-based shell-out.
- Substantial lifecycle, recovery, and runtime-truth improvements
  across Claude Code and Codex managed sessions.
- Sixteen new SQLite migrations (021 → 036) to back the new
  coordination, view, watchdog, and workflow tables, plus a few
  observability and config-profile additions.

## User-Facing Changes

### New coordination commands

A new family of `rig` commands provides a durable, daemon-backed
coordination surface:

- `rig stream` — emit and query stream items; subscribe via SSE.
- `rig queue` — create, claim, hand off, and close queue items.
  Includes `handoff`, `handoff-and-complete`, `update`, `show`,
  `list`, `whoami`, `inbox-drop`, `inbox-absorb`, `outbox-drop`,
  and `outbox-collect`.
- `rig project` — group classified work items into durable projects
  with classifier lease/liveness/reclaim semantics.
- `rig view` — query built-in and custom views over coordination
  state; consume change events via SSE.
- `rig watchdog` — schedule periodic and conditional jobs with
  daemon-native supervision.
- `rig workflow` — run multi-step workflows with durable trail
  records and a workflow-keepalive job.

These commands persist their state in the OpenRig daemon's SQLite
database, are observable through the daemon API, and emit
`view.changed` and related SSE events on update.

### New `starter_ref` member field

`rig up` now accepts `starter_ref` on RigSpec members. The daemon
resolves the named entry from the `agent-starters/` registry at
launch and merges its content into the seat's per-cwd guidance file
(`CLAUDE.md` for Claude, `AGENTS.md` for Codex). Inputs containing
credential markers are refused with a redacted refusal envelope.
`starter_ref` is mutually exclusive with inline `session_source` on
the same member, and is rejected upfront in plan-mode for terminal
runtimes and fork compositions.

### New `session_source` modes

Members may now declare:

- `session_source: { mode: rebuild }` — rebuild a member from a
  named artifact set on every materialize.
- `session_source: { mode: fork }` — fork a new member from an
  existing source on launch.

### Restore-packet command surface

A new `rig restore-packet` family captures restorable conversation
packets across runtimes. It includes parsers and redaction for
Claude and Codex transcripts, schema validation, packet writing, and
a read/validate flow. There is also a `rig restore-check` command
for restore-readiness checks.

### Cross-host operations

`rig ps`, `rig whoami`, `rig send`, and `rig capture` now accept
`--host <ssh-host>` to run against a remote machine. The CLI
shells out over SSH; no long-lived agent or daemon needs to be on
the remote machine ahead of the call.

### Lifecycle, recovery, and runtime-truth improvements

- New lifecycle classifications: `recoverable`, `degraded`, and
  `attention_required`. Codex auth-refusal now surfaces as
  `attention_required` end-to-end.
- `rig up <rigName>` falls back to a manual snapshot when no
  auto-pre-down snapshot exists, so launches no longer fail
  silently in that path.
- Restore now has an explicit attempt id, and runtime-truth
  reconciliation prevents stale state from masquerading as live.
- Codex resume now verifies the pane via a native probe; rig expand
  recovery guidance points to shrink+re-expand instead of trying to
  launch a doomed rig.
- `rig ps --fields` now rejects unknown keys with a per-level
  allow-list. `rig ps` also supports `rigName` aliasing and a
  bounded output mode.

### Agents launched by the daemon now run plain `rig`

Codex seats launched by the daemon previously required an explicit
`OPENRIG_HOME`/`OPENRIG_PORT` env and a non-default binary path on
PATH. Daemon-launched seats now have plain `rig` available, so
agents and operators can use the standard CLI without per-seat env
gymnastics.

### Watchdog help, queue-actor inference, and other small fixes

- `rig watchdog --help` now lists the workflow-keepalive job kind.
- `rig queue` infers the actor from the managed session when no
  explicit actor is provided.
- The CLI bin keeps its executable bit across builds.
- Chatroom wait test fixture is time-stable (no more flaky
  `chatroom wait` test under sanitized environments).

## Operator / Setup Notes

After upgrading the published CLI:

```bash
npm install -g @openrig/cli@0.2.0
rig --version    # expect 0.2.0
```

You will need to restart the daemon to pick up the new schema and
behavior:

```bash
rig daemon stop
rig daemon start
```

The daemon will apply migrations 021-036 to its SQLite database on
first startup. Migrations are forward-only by convention; if you
need to roll back, restore the daemon DB from a snapshot and switch
the daemon binary back to the previous build before restart. Take a
DB snapshot before the first post-upgrade daemon start if you want a
clean rollback path:

```bash
cp ~/.openrig/openrig.sqlite ~/.openrig/openrig.sqlite.pre-v0.2.0.bak
```

If you maintain a managed control-plane environment with live rigs
mid-flight, plan the daemon restart as an upgrade window. The
upgrade is straightforward, but daemon stop/start interrupts active
SSE consumers and any in-progress `rig up` flow.

## Known Limitations

- The new coordination surfaces (`rig stream`, `rig queue`,
  `rig project`, `rig view`, `rig watchdog`, `rig workflow`) are
  daemon-backed. The host daemon must be on v0.2.0 to serve them; an
  older daemon will not expose these commands and may silently
  ignore opt-in fields like `starter_ref` on members.
- `runtime: claude` is not a valid RigSpec runtime spelling; use
  `runtime: claude-code` for Claude managed seats. This is harness/
  spec syntax, not a product limitation, but it has surprised
  operators.
- Watchdog policies and workflow specs are persisted in the daemon
  DB. There is currently no first-class CLI for editing custom
  watchdog policies in bulk; expect more ergonomics in a future
  release.
- The Phase E surfaces (rails, rendering, steering for the
  coordination layer) are intentionally deferred to future product
  lanes (PL-006/PL-007/PL-008) and are not part of v0.2.0.
- Lifecycle classification is more truthful than before, but
  OpenRig still does not have a fully explicit infrastructure-grade
  state machine. Some recovery paths still rely on heuristics
  rather than perfect provider-native primitives.

## Verification Performed

- Sanitized full CLI suite under Node 22 with OpenRig env stripped:
  56 files / 794 tests passing.
- Root `npm run build` and `npm run build:package` passing.
- Real-agent dogfood under Mode 3 isolated VM with VM-local OpenRig
  daemon/state and real OpenRig-managed Claude Code and Codex seats:
  Claude-only, Codex-only, and mixed Claude→Codex paths all
  exercised end-to-end through the new `rig queue`, `rig stream`,
  `rig workflow`, and `rig watchdog` surfaces.
- VM-local global install of `@openrig/cli` from source, with
  `rig --version` reporting the expected version and managed seats
  running plain `rig`.

## Commits Included (highlights)

The full delta from `v0.1.12` to `e40214f` is 117 commits, 277
files changed, 49,209 insertions and 683 deletions. The list below
groups the load-bearing commits by theme:

### Coordination primitive system

- `d8d8ee9 feat(daemon,cli): coordination primitive system — stream/queue/inbox/outbox + hot-potato strict-rejection`
- `fd4fb30 fix(daemon,cli): topology-backed validation + default nudge + handoff-and-complete + whoami + SSE alias + CLI tests`
- `194a1eb fix(daemon): SSE route-order shadowing fix`
- `4ac0d20 feat(daemon,cli): L2 Project (Classifier) + L5 View`
- `9f86df4 fix(daemon,cli): L1→L2 FK + view.changed event bridge`
- `629d061 fix(daemon): queue.updated event + bridge mapping for general state mutations`
- `48c0267 feat(daemon,cli): daemon-native Watchdog supervision tree`
- `dd9820e fix(daemon): watchdog policy POC contract parity + active-wake throttle`
- `1a3b313 fix(daemon): yaml-package frontmatter parser + scan_interval scheduler test`
- `55bdcbb feat(daemon,cli): daemon-native Workflow Runtime + workflow-keepalive`
- `bf28cc2 fix(daemon): workflow projection routes through queue closure primitive + waiting frontier preservation + failed status`
- `1c94719 fix(daemon): durable current-step binding + allowed_exits enforcement at projection`
- `3e32b0a fix(daemon): map exit_not_allowed to HTTP 400 + route regression`
- `05ca19c fix(daemon): workflow_step_trails listForInstance ordered by rowid (deterministic insertion order)`
- `e40214f fix: include workflow keepalive in watchdog help`

### Restore-Packet surface

- `de2dbd4 feat(cli): restore-packet schema + validator + CLI shell + wiring`
- `40d0724 fix(cli): restore-packet schema packaging fix`
- `bdf4cf6 feat(cli): restore-packet runtime parsers + runtime-detect + redaction + omitted-records`
- `5c87145 fix(cli): Claude parser nested tool_use/tool_result handling`
- `e5de3ab feat(cli): packet-writer atomic emission + write action impl`
- `a8401f6 fix(cli): --source-jsonl provenance from parsed session_meta`
- `c7b74fa feat(daemon,cli): full-read transcript route + final M2 regression`
- `a5132da feat(cli): rig restore-packet read + validate actual implementations`
- `ab822ee test(cli): command-registration meta-tests + final regression check`

### Agent Starter v1 vertical

- `eb4acf2 feat(daemon): Agent Starter v1 schema + resolver scaffolding`
- `2673e30 fix(daemon): codec emits starter_ref; expansion preserves it; resolver redacts match-line`
- `2f8f269 feat(daemon): Agent Starter v1 adapter pass-through + rig up integration`
- `6af2754 test(daemon, cli): Agent Starter v1 real-adapter, route end-to-end, CLI plan content, continuityOutcome + SQLite roundtrip`

### session_source rebuild and fork modes

- `c7b6df1 feat(daemon): session_source: { mode: fork } member-level launch input`
- `578bd5c feat(daemon): session_source: { mode: rebuild }`

### Cross-host operations

- `cdce3a6 feat(cli): cross-host rig send/capture via --host (CLI-side ssh shell-out)`

body.body:
# OpenRig v0.1.12

## Summary

This release hardens startup-state truth, improves transcript cleanup, and makes restore/recovery behavior more reliable across Claude and Codex managed sessions.

## Included In This Release

- Normalize user-clearable startup blockers so they do not masquerade as hard failures.
- Clear stale Claude startup/error residue more aggressively.
- Improve Codex restore continuity detection and resume metadata capture.
- Fix transcript redraw and status-noise cleanup.
- Harden Claude managed-session startup around MCP-related blockers.
- Improve operational reliability around tmux health and instantiate timing.

## User-Facing Changes

- Nodes blocked on interactive startup prompts are now normalized as user-clearable startup blockers instead of being left in misleading stale-failure states.
- Claude startup state is cleaned up more aggressively when current runtime evidence proves the old failure residue is stale.
- Codex restore behavior is more robust when resuming wrapped processes and when the TUI has scrolled or rendered extra footer/header noise.
- Transcript cleanup is less noisy and better at removing redraw/status artifacts without leaving the terminal output in a confusing state.

## Operator / Setup Notes

- After upgrading, restart the daemon so new startup and restore behavior is active:

  ```bash
  rig daemon stop
  rig daemon start
  ```

- This release improves classification and recovery behavior, but it does not turn every interrupted runtime into guaranteed native continuity. Operators should still treat restore results honestly and use manual recovery paths when the product says continuity could not be proved.

## Known Limitations

- Lifecycle/state handling is more truthful than before, but OpenRig still does not have a fully explicit infrastructure-grade state machine.
- Restore remains runtime-specific and evidence-driven; some recovery paths still rely on heuristics rather than perfect provider-native primitives.

## Verification Performed

- Targeted daemon and CLI test coverage during the release workstream.
- Focused review and validation of the transcript-cleanup change set.
- Fresh-VM npm-install verification of the published `@openrig/cli` package, including daemon start, health route, doctor checks, `rig ps --nodes`, and UI load.

## Commits Included

- `8b07461` `cli: detect unhealthy tmux control sockets`
- `8ca8e43` `daemon: ignore stale codex update banner once tui is live`

- `848b032` `cli: extend import instantiate timeout budget`

- `37e2d5f` `daemon: normalize user-clearable startup blockers`
